name: imdb-enhanced
description: Desktop IMDb enhancement userscript and Chromium extension

scripts.test:extension: node scripts/build-userscript.js --check && node scripts/build-extension.js --check && node scripts/build-extension.js --firefox --store && node tests/extension.js && node tests/background.js && node tests/gm-contract.js
scripts.test: node scripts/build-userscript.js --check && node scripts/build-extension.js --firefox --store && node tests/run.js && node scripts/run-bounded.js --mb=1536 --seconds=300 -- node tests/dom-fixtures.mjs && node tests/extension.js && node tests/background.js && node tests/gm-contract.js
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.js && node scripts/build-userscript.js && node scripts/build-extension.js && git add src IMDb_Enhanced.user.js extension/content.js extension/recovery.js extension/manifest.json extension/boot.css README.md
scripts.pack: node scripts/build-userscript.js && node scripts/build-extension.js --firefox --store && node scripts/pack.js
